changes: Added scripts/verify-orphan-surface.mjs, wired test:orphan-surface in root and packages/main, retired the old unregistered implementation-review handler, legacy intent-coverage bridge, unexported zod bridge, and generic verifier API source files while preserving dynamic verifier serve/browser support.
usage: Run npm run test:orphan-surface from the repo root or npm --prefix packages/main run test:orphan-surface from packages/main to check handler/catalog orphan surfaces before CI or release.
expectedOutcome: The detector passes on the current repo, catches future handler factories that are defined but not actually registered, and the old implementation_review_result_get command stays unavailable.
actualTranscript: npm run test:orphan-surface passed with 102 handler factories registered, 261 catalog commands checked, and 7 retired surfaces absent. npm --prefix packages/main run test:orphan-surface passed. npm --prefix packages/main run build passed. lattice implementation_review_result_get --help returned Unknown command and suggested signed review commands. lattice validate --story=B-2017 --json passed with 30/30 configured commands and 12/12 verification intents covered.
outcomeDiff: No difference: actual behavior matched the expected detector, build, and retired-command results.
limitations: none - fully covered for the scoped orphan-surface detector and high-confidence legacy surface cleanup
pitfalls: Round 1 review found a real false negative: const-created handler factories were treated as registered even when never consumed by registry.register/registerBatch. Fixed with a self-test. TEST required evidence refresh after review metadata commits, and done_prepare merged main before final closure evidence.
